high_level_description: The image is a page from a scientific paper titled "Hierarchical Reasoning Model." The paper is authored by a team of researchers from Sapient Intelligence, Singapore. The abstract discusses the challenges faced by current large language models (LLMs) in reasoning tasks and introduces the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM), which aims to address these issues. Title: Hierarchical Reasoning Model Authors: Guan Wang, Jin Li, Yuhao Sun, Xing Chen, Changling Liu, Yue Wu, Meng Lu, Sen Song, Yasin Abbasi Yadk
